sloka: अपि ते जीवित अंताय न उत्पन्ना जनकात्मजा ।अपि सीता निमित्तम् च न भवेत् व्यसनम् महत् ॥३-३७-५॥
transliteration: api te jīvita aṁtāya na utpannā janakātmajā ।api sītā nimittam ca na bhavet vyasanam mahat ॥3-37-5॥

translations.english: Hope the daughter of Janaka is not born to put an end to your life. Hope I will not face any disaster on account of Sita.
